Getting Started

Desktop & Mobile Friendly

Estimated reading: 1 minute 859 views

PropertyList.es is designed to be easy to use, regardless of your experience level or technical expertise. With its intuitive interface and comprehensive features, PropertyList.es can help you streamline your workflow and maximize your productivity.

No installation required: PropertyList.es is a cloud-based platform, so there is no need to install any software on your computer or mobile device. Simply create an account and you can start using PropertyList right away.

Mobile-optimised: PropertyList’s responsive design makes it easy to use on any device, including your smartphone or tablet. You can access your listings, manage your leads, and generate reports from anywhere.

Easy to use interface: PropertyList.es has a user-friendly interface that makes it easy to navigate and find the information you need so you can quickly get up to speed on using PropertyList.es
